module.name: carousel
module.title: Carousel
module.description: CSS scroll snap over a plain list. Autoplay is off by default, pauses on hover and focus, and never runs under reduced motion. The dots are real anchors to each slide.

ui.name: carousel
ui.guidance: It is CSS scroll snap over a plain list, so every slide is reachable by scrolling, by keyboard, and with no JavaScript at all. It is deliberately not an ARIA carousel widget: the browser's own scroll container already gives keyboard scrolling and a scrollbar, and re-implementing that as a slideshow would hide the slides that are currently off screen.
ui.keyboard: The scroller is focusable, so arrow keys scroll between slides; no slideshow key model is layered over the browser's own scrolling.

ui.name: carousel-dots
ui.guidance: They are real anchors to each slide's id, so they work with no JavaScript and the browser scrolls the slide into view itself. Each carries the position as text: a row of unlabelled dots is a set of controls a screen reader cannot tell apart.
